Publication statement: [place of publication not identified] : [publisher not identified], 1700.

This early-18th century manuscript map shows the São Francisco River in Brazil's Minas Gerais state. In this period, the Portuguese sent numerous expeditions up the São Francisco and its tributaries in search of gold, silver, and diamonds.
Title devised, in English, by Library staff.
